title: Add GTIN to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports
summary: GTIN codes from item cards are now exported to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD documents with GS1 scheme, enabling recipients to identify invoiced items by their standard product identifier.
key_points: GTIN values are exported with GS1 scheme 0160 to item lines in XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats
Applies to sales invoices and credit memos
Blank GTIN values are omitted from exports
XML regression tests added for both formats
Improves item identification capabilities for retail and service scenarios
